investigation_notes.VirusTotal Detections: 5 Malicious | 0 Suspicious (Community Score -3; 3 community votes flagged malicious)
investigation_notes.Description: A malicious JavaScript component (Trojan:JS/ChatGPTStealer.GVA!MTB) was detected in a Chrome extension directory on WKSTN-SALES-080 and was blacklisted by SentinelOne Cloud with a malicious confidence level. VirusTotal shows multiple engines flagging the file as malicious and the file was executed under chrome.exe, indicating in-browser exposure; remediation actions (kill and quarantine) were performed. Given the confirmed malicious verdict, detection prevalence, and execution context within a browser extension belonging to a sales user, this alert is classified as HP because the component presents a real credential/data exfiltration risk and warrants further investigation of the user's browser extensions, credentials, and potential lateral impact.
